open_points.subject: publish an artifact pointer
open_points.text: As a write of the agent, a publish carries a request id
open_points.question: Is the request id mandatory on every agent publish, and what happens when it is absent?
options: A missing request id is refused
Kernel supplies a request id outside the operation input
The request id is optional and the publish is not replay-safe when absent
open_points.default_guess: Require it and refuse the publish when it is absent.

open_points.subject: publish request replay
open_points.text: a retried publish — the same request id — is not a second publish and returns the pointer it made
open_points.question: Within what namespace must a request id be unique: globally, per agent session, per project, or per session and operation?
options: Unique per agent session and operation
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as unique per agent session and operation.

open_points.subject: publish request replay
open_points.text: a retried publish — the same request id — is not a second publish and returns the pointer it made
open_points.question: What happens when the same request id is presented with a different project, type, uri, payload_ref or digest from the publish that first used it?
options: Refuse the request-id reuse as conflicting
Return the original pointer regardless of the changed input
Treat it as a new publish
open_points.default_guess: Refuse it as conflicting request-id reuse.

open_points.subject: publish request replay
open_points.text: a retry that is still allowed — the project still in the session's set and not archived — returns the pointer it made
open_points.question: Does a refused publish consume its request id, and what does a later call with that id do when the cause of refusal has been corrected?
options: Only a successful publish binds the request id
The refusal is replayed for that request id
The later corrected call is refused as conflicting reuse
open_points.default_guess: Bind the request id only after a successful publish.

open_points.subject: artifact pointer publisher
open_points.question: What publisher fact must Registry record from these texts alone: only owner versus agent-through-Kernel, the agent session identity, the authenticated Kernel principal, or some combination; and through which action is that fact observable?
options: Record owner or the agent session id
Record both the authenticated principal and agent session id
Defer the fact and its observability explicitly as an open State 1 question
open_points.default_guess: Record owner or agent-through-Kernel plus the agent session id, and return it wherever the pointer is returned.
